families.title: Fuel burned in fixed equipment
families.description: Collect fuel evidence for confirmed ovens, boilers, heaters and other fixed equipment. Generators have a separate collection card; reconcile any shared fuel once.

checklist.label: Map equipment to each location
checklist.help: List asset IDs, purpose, ownership or control, operating dates, fuel type and shared meters.

checklist.label: Collect fuel bills and meter readings
checklist.help: Keep service dates, supplier, meter ID, original quantity and unit. Mark missing or estimated periods.

checklist.label: Reconcile fuel purchases and use
checklist.help: Document tank opening/closing stocks, deliveries, transfers and non-combustion uses. Do not count commodity and delivery invoices twice.

checklist.label: Preserve fuel specifications and evidence
checklist.help: Retain available fuel composition, blend and heating-value documentation with its measurement basis. Record the evidence owner and unresolved questions.

subtypes.label: Oven or cooking equipment
subtypes.help: Fuel-fired cooking, baking or curing equipment.

checklist.label: Identify burners and fuel supply
checklist.help: Record oven/burner IDs and whether consumption is individually metered or shares a site meter.

subtypes.label: Boiler or water heater
subtypes.help: Equipment producing hot water or steam from fuel.

checklist.label: Map boilers and steam destinations
checklist.help: Identify boilers, fuels and shared supplies. Distinguish purchased steam from steam generated on site.

subtypes.label: Furnace or space heater
subtypes.help: Fuel burned for building heat.

checklist.label: Check all heated spaces
checklist.help: Include workshops, warehouses and auxiliary heaters within the agreed boundary.

subtypes.label: Kiln, dryer or process heater
subtypes.help: Combustion heat used in production.

checklist.label: Separate fuel and process chemistry
checklist.help: Collect fuel records and flag reactions or feedstocks that may release gas independently of combustion.

subtypes.label: Fuel-fired torch or cutting equipment
subtypes.help: For example propane or acetylene burned during work.

checklist.label: Identify fuel cylinders and use
checklist.help: Separate fuel gases from shielding gases; retain cylinder contents, returns and consumption records.

subtypes.label: Flare or thermal oxidizer
subtypes.help: Combustion of process or waste gas; specialist review.

checklist.label: Retain waste-gas operating evidence
checklist.help: Collect gas composition, flow, operating periods and available monitoring records for a method review.

subtypes.label: Biomass or mixed waste fuel
subtypes.help: Track fuel composition; no automatic zero-emission assumption.

checklist.label: Identify fossil and biogenic components
checklist.help: Retain feedstock, blend, moisture and supplier evidence. Keep biogenic reporting questions visible.

subtypes.label: Other or unknown fixed source
subtypes.help: Use when equipment, fuel or method is not yet clear.

checklist.label: Describe the source for review
checklist.help: Attach a nameplate, site description or supplier record and assign an owner to resolve fuel and method.

families.title: Generators and on-site power
families.description: A collection group for fuel-burning power equipment. This overlaps stationary combustion in accounting; avoid duplicating fuel in the fixed-equipment card.

checklist.label: List generators and responsibility
checklist.help: Record site, asset ID, fuel, engine type, ownership/control and operating dates, including hired units.

checklist.label: Collect fuel and tank records
checklist.help: Retain deliveries, meter readings, opening/closing stock and transfers, separated from vehicle and other site fuel.

checklist.label: Keep operating and test logs
checklist.help: Identify routine tests, outages, other operating periods and any metered output. Runtime alone is not measured fuel use.

checklist.label: Reconcile shared supply
checklist.help: Link the same fuel evidence to a single allocation record; explain any estimates or missing periods.

subtypes.label: Standby or emergency generator
subtypes.help: Includes periodic testing.

checklist.label: Include test runs
checklist.help: Collect test and outage logs even when there was no extended power outage.

subtypes.label: Prime-power generator
subtypes.help: Regular electricity production.

checklist.label: Separate output and fuel
checklist.help: Retain output meters and fuel records; identify exported versus on-site electricity without netting fuel use.

subtypes.label: Combined heat and power
subtypes.help: Produces electricity and useful heat; specialist method review.

checklist.label: Document both energy outputs
checklist.help: Collect fuel, electricity and useful heat records with export and consumption destinations.

subtypes.label: Portable or rented generator
subtypes.help: Track the actual operating boundary.

checklist.label: Confirm operator and fuel responsibility
checklist.help: Retain hire agreements, site dates and who supplied fuel; request scope classification review if uncertain.

subtypes.label: Other or unknown generation
subtypes.help: For an unlisted technology or unclear operating arrangement.

checklist.label: Describe generation technology
checklist.help: Identify fuel-burning versus non-combustion equipment and preserve the classification question for review.

families.title: Vehicles and mobile equipment
families.description: Collect records for owned or controlled fuel-burning vehicles and equipment. Electricity and outsourced transport need separate scope classification.

checklist.label: Build the vehicle and equipment register
checklist.help: Record asset ID, type, model year, fuel, site and ownership/control; include assets added or retired in the year.

checklist.label: Collect fuel consumption by fuel type
checklist.help: Keep fuel-card exports, receipts and depot withdrawals with dates and original units.

checklist.label: Retain distance and operating evidence
checklist.help: Record vehicle distance, odometer dates or equipment runtime where available; identify estimates explicitly.

checklist.label: Reconcile shared tanks and third parties
checklist.help: Separate stationary fuel, hired transport, employee travel and charging electricity. Resolve lease/control uncertainty.

subtypes.label: Cars, vans or pickup trucks
subtypes.help: Company-operated road fleet.

checklist.label: Retain model year and odometers
checklist.help: Map fuel-card entries and vehicle distance to each vehicle or documented fleet grouping.

subtypes.label: Heavy trucks or buses
subtypes.help: Fuel use may include substantial idling.

checklist.label: Check idling and auxiliary equipment
checklist.help: Identify separate auxiliary engines and whether their fuel is already in the vehicle total.

subtypes.label: Construction or agricultural equipment
subtypes.help: For example loaders, excavators or tractors.

checklist.label: Identify equipment and engine use
checklist.help: Retain fuel withdrawals, equipment class and hours; do not treat runtime as fuel without a reviewed estimate.

subtypes.label: Forklifts or material-handling equipment
subtypes.help: Fuel-powered or electric; confirm actual power source.

checklist.label: Separate fuel and charging
checklist.help: Track LPG cylinders or other fuel by machine; route purchased electricity to the energy checklist.

subtypes.label: Small engines and grounds equipment
subtypes.help: For example mowers, pumps and portable machinery.

checklist.label: Capture small fuel purchases
checklist.help: Document fuel type and which equipment used shared cans or tanks.

subtypes.label: Vessels, locomotives or aircraft
subtypes.help: Specialist classification and method review.

checklist.label: Collect operating detail for review
checklist.help: Record engine/vehicle type, fuel, routes or operating areas, activity periods and available logs.

subtypes.label: Other or unknown mobile source
subtypes.help: Unlisted equipment, mixed fuels or uncertain control.

checklist.label: Resolve the equipment boundary
checklist.help: Describe the machine and working arrangement; assign fuel and scope questions to a reviewer.

families.title: Refrigerants and released gases
families.description: Collect gas identities and movement records. A purchase or refill is evidence to reconcile, not automatically the quantity emitted.

checklist.label: Identify gases and equipment
checklist.help: Record equipment/site IDs, exact gas or blend name, nameplate charge and ownership/control.

checklist.label: Collect service and gas movement records
checklist.help: Retain additions, recoveries, purchases, sales, returns and beginning/ending storage quantities with original units.

checklist.label: Record installation, leaks and retirement
checklist.help: Retain contractor logs, new equipment charging, discharge events and recovered gas at disposal.

checklist.label: Resolve missing gas identity or quantities
checklist.help: Request supplier composition and measured mass evidence. Do not assign a gas or zero leak from an invoice total.

records.label: Gas movement or measured release — identify event type

subtypes.label: Refrigeration or cold storage
subtypes.help: Commercial, industrial or transport refrigeration.

checklist.label: Map refrigeration circuits
checklist.help: Record circuit charges and servicing, including equipment installed or disposed of during the period.

subtypes.label: Air conditioning or heat pumps
subtypes.help: Building or vehicle systems within the boundary.

checklist.label: Obtain service records
checklist.help: Ask the service provider for gas identity, quantities added/recovered and equipment IDs.

subtypes.label: Fire suppression
subtypes.help: Only identify actual extinguishing agents; not every agent is a GHG.

checklist.label: Confirm agent and events
checklist.help: Retain cylinder labels, agent composition, discharges, refills and decommissioning recoveries.

subtypes.label: Purchased industrial or shielding gas
subtypes.help: For example CO2-containing welding mixtures; gas composition matters.

checklist.label: Reconcile cylinders and mixtures
checklist.help: Collect gas specifications, quantities, stock changes and returns. Distinguish released gas from fuel burned in a torch.

subtypes.label: Gas-insulated electrical equipment
subtypes.help: For example SF6-containing switchgear; specialist review.

checklist.label: Collect utility or maintenance records
checklist.help: Identify insulating gas, equipment charge, top-ups, recovery and responsibility for the equipment.

subtypes.label: Fuel handling, storage or distribution leaks
subtypes.help: For example methane leaks; separate from fuel combustion.

checklist.label: Retain leak and vent evidence
checklist.help: Describe components, inspections, repairs, measurements and known venting; request a source-specific method review.

subtypes.label: Other or unknown gas release
subtypes.help: Aerosols, foams, solvents or other unusual applications need review.

checklist.label: Describe material and release pathway
checklist.help: Collect safety/specification sheets and process records. Confirm whether a GHG is present before quantification.

families.title: Process and other direct sources
families.description: Discovery and specialist-review route for direct sources beyond ordinary fuel use. Selection does not approve a sector method or establish scope.

checklist.label: Describe each activity and release pathway
checklist.help: Map site, process, ownership/control and operating dates. Identify combustion and purchased gas already recorded elsewhere.

checklist.label: Collect production and material evidence
checklist.help: Keep input/output quantities, composition, process diagrams, monitoring records and original units where available.

checklist.label: Assign a source-specific review
checklist.help: Name the responsible specialist and track gas identity, classification, method, boundary and evidence questions as unresolved.

checklist.label: Document coverage and exclusions
checklist.help: Keep a reason and supporting evidence for every excluded activity. Missing measurements are not zero emissions.

subtypes.label: Chemical reactions or material transformation
subtypes.help: Includes mineral, metal and chemical production; specialist review.

checklist.label: Describe reactions and material balances
checklist.help: Identify feedstocks, products, by-products, composition and any direct gas measurements.

subtypes.label: Fermentation or biological processing
subtypes.help: A discovery route, including food/beverage operations where present.

checklist.label: Document feedstocks and gas handling
checklist.help: Identify process volumes, gas recovery/release and possible biogenic treatment for review.

subtypes.label: On-site wastewater treatment
subtypes.help: Confirm ownership/control and distinguish contracted treatment.

checklist.label: Describe treatment and sludge handling
checklist.help: Collect flow, available organic-load tests, treatment type, sludge routes and gas capture records.

subtypes.label: On-site waste, composting or digestion
subtypes.help: Specialist review; off-site contracted waste is screened separately.

checklist.label: Map waste streams and gas capture
checklist.help: Collect waste types/masses, treatment processes, operating dates and recovery/flare records.

subtypes.label: Livestock, soils or crop activities
subtypes.help: Enteric fermentation, manure, soil inputs and rice require sector review.

checklist.label: Collect an activity description
checklist.help: Identify livestock classes, manure systems, land area, fertilizer applications and relevant seasonal practices.

subtypes.label: Land-use change or land management
subtypes.help: Flag land emissions and removals for separate specialist evaluation.

checklist.label: Document land and management changes
checklist.help: Retain locations, area, dates, prior/current use and ownership/control. Do not net assumed removals against fuel emissions.

subtypes.label: Semiconductor or other process gases
subtypes.help: Specialist review of gas use, conversion and abatement.

checklist.label: Preserve gas and abatement data
checklist.help: Record gas identity, input quantities, process routes and available control-system operating evidence.

subtypes.label: Other or unknown direct source
subtypes.help: Use this catch-all rather than omitting an unlisted activity.

checklist.label: Create a source-review question
checklist.help: Describe materials, physical activity, possible gas release and available records; assign an owner and due date.

scope2.title: Purchased electricity
scope2.description: Include utility, landlord and directly supplied electricity consumed within the boundary.

checklist.label: Collect electricity statements
checklist.help: Retain meters, supplier, site, service dates and consumed kWh or MWh; record gaps and estimates.

checklist.label: Reconcile imports and on-site generation
checklist.help: Separate consumption, self-generation, exports and charging records to avoid duplicate totals.

checklist.label: Retain contract and attribute evidence
checklist.help: Collect tariffs, supplier information and any energy certificates or retirement records for later quality review.

checklist.label: Document location and allocation
checklist.help: Keep service address/grid location and any landlord or shared-meter allocation evidence.

scope2.title: Purchased steam
scope2.description: Collect purchased steam separately from steam produced by your own boilers.

checklist.label: Collect steam delivery records
checklist.help: Preserve quantity, unit, service dates, supplier and metering location.

checklist.label: Record steam characteristics
checklist.help: Retain available pressure, temperature, condensate return and energy-content information.

checklist.label: Request supplier generation evidence
checklist.help: Ask for fuel mix, efficiency or emissions documentation and any shared-production allocation.

checklist.label: Resolve shared use and contracts
checklist.help: Keep tenant allocations and contractual claims for review; mark missing information.

scope2.title: Purchased heat
scope2.description: District or other externally supplied heat.

checklist.label: Collect heat statements
checklist.help: Keep delivered energy, unit, supplier, site and service period.

checklist.label: Record supply technology
checklist.help: Request supplier fuel and generation information, including shared heat/power production where applicable.

checklist.label: Retain allocation records
checklist.help: Explain shared meters and landlord estimates with original supporting evidence.

checklist.label: Retain contractual claims
checklist.help: Keep relevant supply contracts for later review; do not infer zero emissions.

scope2.title: Purchased cooling
scope2.description: District chilled water or other externally supplied cooling.

checklist.label: Collect cooling delivery records
checklist.help: Keep quantity, original unit, supplier, site, meter and period.

checklist.label: Record delivered-energy basis
checklist.help: Retain available temperature, flow and equipment-performance evidence if bills give non-energy units.

checklist.label: Request supplier energy information
checklist.help: Document how cooling is produced and available supplier emissions evidence.

checklist.label: Separate customer equipment
checklist.help: Avoid confusing purchased cooling with electricity for your own chillers or refrigerant servicing.

scope3.title: 1. Purchased goods and services
scope3.description: Goods and services acquired during the reporting year.

checklist.label: Reconcile purchasing records
checklist.help: Collect supplier, product/service, quantity, original unit, dates and value with currency; separate capital purchases.

checklist.label: Request supplier evidence
checklist.help: Keep product-level emissions or activity data, boundaries, period and allocation notes.

checklist.label: Record gaps and classification
checklist.help: Identify missing suppliers or quantities and any spend-only screening assumptions.

scope3.title: 2. Capital goods
scope3.description: Equipment, buildings and other capital goods acquired in the year.

checklist.label: Collect capital additions
checklist.help: Reconcile fixed-asset additions with procurement; capture quantity, supplier, dates and asset type.

checklist.label: Collect product or project evidence
checklist.help: Request embodied-production data with scope and allocation information.

checklist.label: Check purchase classification
checklist.help: Document the financial classification and avoid duplicating the same acquisition under goods and services.

scope3.title: 3. Fuel- and energy-related activities
scope3.description: Upstream fuel/energy activities and losses outside Scope 1 and 2.

checklist.label: Reuse reconciled energy quantities
checklist.help: Link fuel and purchased-energy consumption by type, location and period; do not duplicate direct combustion.

checklist.label: Request upstream and loss data
checklist.help: Keep supplier or grid data with geography, year and lifecycle boundaries.

checklist.label: Screen energy resale
checklist.help: Identify purchased energy sold to end users and request a separate classification review when relevant.

scope3.title: 4. Upstream transportation and distribution
scope3.description: Third-party inbound transport and transport services purchased by the company.

checklist.label: Map purchased transport services
checklist.help: Identify freight legs, warehouses, payor and operator; include purchased outbound services where applicable.

checklist.label: Collect shipment activity
checklist.help: Retain mode, origin/destination, distance, mass, loading and storage information where available.

checklist.label: Reconcile supplier records
checklist.help: Keep carrier fuel/emissions evidence and mark missing legs or estimates.

scope3.title: 5. Waste generated in operations
scope3.description: Waste from operations treated by other organizations.

checklist.label: Collect waste and wastewater records
checklist.help: List stream, quantity, unit, date and receiving operator.

checklist.label: Identify treatment routes
checklist.help: Retain disposal, recycling, composting or treatment evidence and destination.

checklist.label: Resolve boundary and gaps
checklist.help: Separate owned/controlled treatment and preserve assumptions for unknown treatment routes.

scope3.title: 6. Business travel
scope3.description: Employee business travel using third-party transport.

checklist.label: Collect trip activity
checklist.help: Retain mode, route, distance and travel class where available; identify covered period.

checklist.label: Reconcile travel systems
checklist.help: Compare agency exports, expenses and corporate cards; avoid duplicates.

checklist.label: Document optional activity coverage
checklist.help: Record whether hotel stays and other optional elements are included and explain missing records.

scope3.title: 7. Employee commuting
scope3.description: Travel between employees' homes and workplaces.

checklist.label: Collect representative commute data
checklist.help: Use privacy-preserving totals for mode, distance, commuting days and occupancy.

checklist.label: Document survey coverage
checklist.help: Retain respondent coverage, sampling period and extrapolation assumptions.

checklist.label: Record work-pattern boundaries
checklist.help: Identify remote/hybrid arrangements and whether optional homeworking emissions are considered.

scope3.title: 8. Upstream leased assets
scope3.description: Assets leased by the company and outside its Scope 1 and 2 boundary.

checklist.label: Review lease register
checklist.help: Identify assets, lessors, lease dates and accounting/control treatment.

checklist.label: Request asset operating data
checklist.help: Collect fuel, energy and other relevant emissions evidence from the lessor.

checklist.label: Resolve allocations
checklist.help: Retain floor area, occupancy or other allocation basis and avoid duplicate Scope 1/2 records.

scope3.title: 9. Downstream transportation and distribution
scope3.description: Downstream third-party distribution outside purchased transport services.

checklist.label: Map post-sale movement
checklist.help: Identify distribution legs, retailers, storage and who pays for transport.

checklist.label: Collect physical activity
checklist.help: Request shipment quantities, modes, distances and storage-energy evidence.

checklist.label: Check category boundary
checklist.help: Separate company-purchased transport already screened in Category 4 and document unavailable downstream data.

scope3.title: 10. Processing of sold products
scope3.description: Further processing of intermediate products sold by the company.

checklist.label: Identify intermediate products
checklist.help: Record quantities, customers or customer groups and likely further processing.

checklist.label: Request processing information
checklist.help: Collect customer energy/process data or documented processing scenarios.

checklist.label: Record allocation and gaps
checklist.help: Explain the share attributable to sold products and uncertainty in downstream pathways.

scope3.title: 11. Use of sold products
scope3.description: Use over the expected lifetime of products sold during the year.

checklist.label: Map products and use pathways
checklist.help: Record sales volumes, product types and direct energy, fuel or gas-release activity during use.

checklist.label: Document lifetime assumptions
checklist.help: Retain expected lifespan, usage rate, efficiency and regional scenarios.

checklist.label: Separate optional indirect use
checklist.help: Record which indirect use activities are considered and why; keep uncertainty visible.

scope3.title: 12. End-of-life treatment of sold products
scope3.description: Disposal and treatment of products and packaging sold during the year.

checklist.label: Collect sold-material quantities
checklist.help: Record product/packaging mass and composition by material type.

checklist.label: Document disposal scenarios
checklist.help: Retain treatment routes, regional assumptions and expected recycling/disposal shares.

checklist.label: Keep evidence and uncertainty
checklist.help: Identify supplier/customer evidence and unknown destinations without assuming universal recycling.

scope3.title: 13. Downstream leased assets
scope3.description: Assets owned by the company and leased to others outside Scope 1 and 2.

checklist.label: Review lessor asset register
checklist.help: Collect asset type, lessee, location, lease dates and boundary decision.

checklist.label: Request lessee operating data
checklist.help: Collect relevant fuel, energy and other operational emissions information.

checklist.label: Retain allocation basis
checklist.help: Document leased share, use periods and estimates; avoid double counting consolidated operations.

scope3.title: 14. Franchises
scope3.description: Franchises outside the company's Scope 1 and 2 boundary.

checklist.label: Collect franchise register
checklist.help: List franchise locations, agreement periods and control/boundary decisions.

checklist.label: Request operating data
checklist.help: Collect franchise fuel, electricity and other relevant operational emissions evidence.

checklist.label: Document estimation coverage
checklist.help: Retain data coverage, proxy-site selection, allocation and gaps.

scope3.title: 15. Investments
scope3.description: Investment activities outside the company's Scope 1 and 2 boundary.

checklist.label: Screen investment portfolio
checklist.help: Identify equity, debt, project finance and other investments, with values, shares and dates.

checklist.label: Request investee evidence
checklist.help: Collect investee/project emissions, reporting boundaries and period.

checklist.label: Assign specialist boundary review
checklist.help: Resolve category applicability and attribution before any financed-emissions calculation.
